title: Türkiye'de Sağlık Politikası Belgeleri, 1920–2026: Tekrarlanabilirlik Paketi (Turkiye Health Policy 1920–2026 Reproducibility Package)
description: Code, parameters, source inventory (official URLs and SHA-256 hashes) and expected outputs that reproduce all computational analyses of the article 'Türkiye'de Sağlık Kurumlarının Kurumsal Çevresi ve Teknolojik Dönüşümü (1920–2026): Politika Belgelerinin Sağlık Yönetimi Perspektifinden Tarihsel Nicel Metin Analizi'. The corpus comprises 84 documents (63 government programmes, 12 development plans, 9 annual programmes). Source PDFs are not redistributed; a download script retrieves them from official sites and verifies their hashes. run_all.py executes text extraction, OCR, dictionary-based health-sentence detection, 14-theme coding, WHO six-building-block mapping, measurement of four technology and innovation categories (domestic production, medical devices, information systems and digital health, R&D), statistical tests and figures, and compares 572 reported values with the article (572/572 reproduced). Blank blind forms for two independent human coders (160 + 266 records) and inter-coder agreement code are included; no human validation results are included because none has yet been carried out.
notes: Code: MIT. Derived data, tables, figures and documentation: CC BY 4.0. Original policy documents are not included.
